title: CRA Article 14 notification (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED from the prose of Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Art 14(2), 14(4), 14(5), 14(6), 14(7) and Art 16(2). The Regulation defines no schema, field names or encoding; Art 14(10) leaves format to an implementing act (none adopted as of 2026-10-02). Property names are ours; every property's description quotes the source phrase and locator. Not ENISA SRP form fields. 'required' reflects 'including at least' / 'shall provide'; 'where available / as available / where applicable' fields are optional. Clock fields (aware_at, measure_available_at, incident_notification_submitted_at) are inferred: they are the deadline origins the text uses.

subject.description: Art 14(1) 'actively exploited vulnerability' / Art 14(3) 'severe incident having an impact on the security of the product with digital elements'

main_establishment_member_state.description: Art 14(7) second subparagraph: where cybersecurity decisions are predominantly taken, else largest EU establishment by employees

csirt_selection_basis.description: Art 14(7) third subparagraph (a)-(d) order for manufacturers without EU main establishment; fourth subparagraph allows reuse of first CSIRT after point (d)

product.description: Art 14(2)(b) 'general information, as available, about the product with digital elements concerned'

type_or_identifier.description: Art 13(15) type, batch or serial number

aware_at.description: INFERRED clock origin: 'within 24 hours / 72 hours of the manufacturer becoming aware' (Art 14(2)(a),(b); 14(4)(a),(b))

member_states_made_available.description: Art 14(2)(a) / 14(4)(a) 'indicating, where applicable, the Member States on the territory of which the manufacturer is aware that their product with digital elements has been made available' — drives Art 16(2) dissemination

suspected_unlawful_or_malicious.description: Art 14(4)(a) 'including at least whether the incident is suspected of being caused by unlawful or malicious acts'

severity_ground.description: Art 14(5): guard for treating an incident as severe; not a required report field (inferred)

exploit_general_nature.description: Art 14(2)(b) 'the general nature of the exploit'

incident_nature.description: Art 14(4)(b) 'general information, where available, about the nature of the incident'

initial_assessment.description: Art 14(4)(b) 'an initial assessment of the incident'

corrective_measures_taken.description: Art 14(2)(b)/(4)(b) 'any corrective or mitigating measures taken'

user_mitigations.description: Art 14(2)(b)/(4)(b) 'corrective or mitigating measures that users can take'

sensitivity.description: Art 14(2)(b)/(4)(b) 'how sensitive the manufacturer considers the notified information to be' (no scale given; TLP is named only in Delegated Reg 2026/881 Art 3)

exceptional_circumstances.description: Art 16(2) third subparagraph, indicated in the Art 14(2)(b) notification

dissemination_delay_requested.description: Art 16(2) second subparagraph 'upon request by the manufacturer'

description.description: final report: Art 14(2)(c)(i) 'a description of the vulnerability, including its severity and impact' / Art 14(4)(c)(i) 'a detailed description of the incident, including its severity and impact'

malicious_actor_information.description: Art 14(2)(c)(ii) 'where available, information concerning any malicious actor that has exploited or that is exploiting the vulnerability'

security_update_details.description: Art 14(2)(c)(iii) 'details about the security update or other corrective measures that have been made available to remedy the vulnerability'

measure_available_at.description: INFERRED clock origin for Art 14(2)(c) 'no later than 14 days after a corrective or mitigating measure is available'

threat_type_or_root_cause.description: Art 14(4)(c)(ii) 'the type of threat or root cause that is likely to have triggered the incident'

incident_notification_submitted_at.description: INFERRED clock origin for Art 14(4)(c) 'within one month after the submission of the incident notification under point (b)'

status_updates.description: Art 14(6) 'an intermediate report on relevant status updates' (only on CSIRT request)

already_provided.description: Art 14(2)(b),(c); 14(4)(b),(c) 'unless the relevant information has already been provided' — a later stage may be satisfied by an earlier submission
